# sintaks.dev documentation

> Technical reference for the sintaks.dev OpenAI-compatible AI API.

## Start here

- Indonesian quickstart: https://docs.sintaks.dev/id/
- English quickstart: https://docs.sintaks.dev/en/
- Authentication: https://docs.sintaks.dev/id/guides/authentication/
- Pricing and IDR balance: https://docs.sintaks.dev/id/guides/pricing/
- SDKs and libraries: https://docs.sintaks.dev/id/guides/sdks/
- API endpoints: https://docs.sintaks.dev/id/reference/endpoints/
- OpenAPI spec: https://docs.sintaks.dev/openapi.yaml
- Error reference: https://docs.sintaks.dev/id/reference/errors/

## API

- Base URL: https://api.sintaks.dev/v1
- Chat: POST /v1/chat/completions
- Images: POST /v1/images/generations
- Authentication: Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>

## Ownership

sintaks.dev is owned and operated by PT Trakk Digital Indonesia, the company behind https://trakk.id/.
